name: L.G. Balakrishnan & Bros Limited
summary: L.G. Balakrishnan & Bros Limited manufactures and sells chains, sprockets, and metal formed parts for automotive and industrial applications in India and internationally. The company operates through Transmission and Metal Forming segments.
